groups.printed: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Master of Interrogation
choices.text: If your army includes a model with this Warlord trait, your opponent may not deploy models via the Infiltration special rule during the deployment step and suffers -1 to all rolls when determining if a unit will arrive via Outflank.

choices.name: Sanctic Will
choices.text: Your Warlord and any attached unit gain the Stubborn and Indomitable Spirit (2+) special rules.

choices.name: Xeno-Tech Armoury
choices.text:
If your Warlord has this trait, units in your army may exchange their Boltgun for

- A Shuriken Catapult for 0pts.
- A Splinter Rifle for 1pts.
- A Pulse Rifle for 2pts.
- A Pulse Carbine for 2pts.
- An Ion Blaster for 5pts.

Models in your army may exchange their Power Sword for:

- A Witchblade for 5pts.
- A Dire Sword for 5pts.
- An Agonizer for 10pts.
- A Void Blade for 15pts.
- A Plasma Axe for 10pts.

groups.label: An Imperial Agent Ordo Hereticus or Ordo Malleus Psyker with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.printed: An Imperial Agent Ordo Hereticus or Ordo Malleus Psyker with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.name: Sanctic Psychic Powers

choices.name: Banishment
choices.text: When this power is cast, Select 1 enemy unit within 12" the Psyker with the Daemon special rule. That unit has -1 to its invulnerable Saves until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Gate of Infinity
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit are removed from the Battlefield. The unit may then be placed anywhere back on the Battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models. A unit which performs this Psychic Power and its attached unit this turn, may not declare a Charge in the Charge Phase.

choices.name: Hammerhand
choices.text:
A Psyker is equipped with the following Psychic weapon:

- Hammerhand

choices.name: Sanctuary
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and al friendly units within 12" gain a 6+ Invulnerable Save. Any unit that already has an Invulnerable Save gain +1 to their Invulnerable Save (to a Max of 3+). This lasts until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Vortex of Doom
choices.text: When this power is cast, place 1 Vortex Marker within 12" of the Psyker. A Vortex Marker should be no larger than a 25mm Base. Only 1 Vortex of Doom can be cast at once. If another unit attempts to Cast this Psychic Power, the previous Vortex Marker is removed and a new once is placed down. If a Vortex marker has been placed down already, a unit that knows this Psychic Power can attempt to cast this Psychic Power again to either place a new Vortex marker or move the existing Marker 2D6". All units that end their Movement Phase within 6" of the Vortex marker take D6, Strength 10, AP1 automatic hits.

groups.label: An Imperial Agent Ordo Xeno Psyker with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.printed: An Imperial Agent Ordo Xeno Psyker with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.name: Xenopurge Psychic Powers

choices.name: Fortified With Contempt
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Feel No Pain (6+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Mantle of Shadow
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit cannot be targeted for Shooting Attacks in your opponents Shooting Phase unless they are the closest visible enemy unit. This lasts until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Neural Void
choices.text: When this power is cast, enemy units within 3" of the Psyker or their attached unit halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Psychic Cleanse
choices.text: When this power is cast, all enemy units within 6" of the Psyker take 2D6 automatic hits resolved at Strength 4, AP4 with the Deflagrate special rule.

choices.name: Severance
choices.text: When this power is cast, enemy model in an enemy unit within 12" of the Psyker. The target enemy model's Leadership (LD) characteristic may not be used for Leadership tests that unit is called to make until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.label: Any Imperial Agent unit with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.printed: Any Imperial Agent unit with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.name: Litany of Prayers

choices.name: Litany of Focus
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Hatred
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Rage
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Fear (1) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Strength
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.label: Any Imperial Agent unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule may purchase the following Rites:
groups.printed: Any Imperial Agent unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule may purchase the following Rites:
groups.name: Machine Rites

choices.name: Rite of Consecration
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit gains the Indomitable Spirit (6+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Rite of Immolation
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately suffers an Explodes result per the Vehicle Damage Chart, even if it would normally not.

choices.name: Rite of Reloading
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately makes a Shooting Attack with 1 weapon it is equipped with.

choices.name: Rite of Repair
choices.text:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:

- Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3" or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
- Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
- Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.
